name: application-claim-status-tracker
title: Claim Status Tracker
description: Vertical timeline for an insurance claim's submitted -> review -> approved/denied stages, with completed stages and the final outcome badge computed from real currentStageIndex/outcome props.
useWhen: Showing the progress of an insurance (or similar review) claim through a small number of sequential stages.
The process can branch to either an approved or denied outcome, and that outcome needs distinct styling from an in-progress stage.
Each stage benefits from a real or estimated date, not just a label.
avoidWhen: You need a horizontal shipment/order stepper — use `order-status-tracker` for that linear, non-branching flow instead.
The process has no branching outcome — a simpler linear progress stepper is enough.
There are more than four or five stages — a vertical timeline this dense should switch to a more compact log/list view.
responsiveBehavior: Fixed-width card (max-w-sm) with a vertical timeline; stage text wraps rather than overflowing at narrow widths.
accessibility: Stage completion (checkmark vs. empty circle) and connecting-line color are both derived from the same currentStageIndex, so they can never disagree.
The denied outcome is conveyed with a distinct icon (X vs. checkmark), color, and text label together, never by color alone.
Stage labels and dates remain real text content, fully readable to screen readers, with an ordered list (<ol>) preserving sequence.
